official_title: District-wise Gross Enrollment Ratio of Boys in Primary Schools of Punjab from 2019 to 2022 (April to March)
publisher: data.gov.in (Punjab Dept. of Economic and Statistical Organization)
notes: 8-resource catalog split by level x gender, each ingested separately with its own resource id. Anomaly engine found a consistent, high-confidence pattern: SAS Nagar (Mohali) district's GER climbs to 124-145% by 2022, well above every peer district, across nearly every level and gender, backed by a real multi-year rise in the raw values, not a single outlier.
